about_the_game:
Introduction

Oiran Survival is a Japanese dark action RPG set in the red-light district of Edo.
Play as the alluring courtesan Kochou and face relentless swarms of yokai.
Unleash dazzling attacks and powerful skills to obliterate hundreds of enemies in seconds.

Key Features

  • Genre: Action RPG (Vampire Survivors style)

  • Playable Character: Courtesan "Kochou"

  • Action: Fast-paced combat, flashy skills, and power-ups through leveling

  • Stage Structure: 5 Normal stages, 5 Coin stages, 5 Hard stages (more coming via updates)

  • Boss Battles: 10 massive and unique bosses

  • Playtime: Each stage lasts about 7–8 minutes for quick play sessions

  • Visuals: 3D presentation enhanced with Live2D effects

  • Worldview: A fusion of Japanese horror and the dazzling Edo courtesan district

Steam Features

  • Steam Achievements supported

  • Available in Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese

  • Controller not supported (keyboard and mouse recommended)

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent combat scenes and mild blood effects when defeating enemies. No sexual content or nudity is present.

short_description: Set in the dazzling Edo red-light district, courtesan Kochou faces relentless yokai in this action RPG. Cut down hundreds of foes, rescue the Twelve Zodiac Children, and battle mighty bosses. Enjoy fast-paced stages and a dark Japanese fantasy world in 3D and Live2D.
